id.description: Laser id, e.g. NL1. Becomes the <LASER> segment of every PV (BI_<id>_CONN). Panels render in file order.

mssCount.description: Number of MSS sub-indicators (BI_<id>_MSS_1..N) counted in the General overview bar.

modboxCount.description: Number of Modbox state indicators (BI_<id>_MODBOX_1..N). 0 hides the Modbox section.

channelsPerBox.description: Flashlamp channels per box (SI_<id>_FL_<box>_CH1..CHn). Almost always 2.

chillerIds.description: Chiller ids. Each renders a row reading AI_<id>_CHILLER_<cid>_FLOW/TEMP/LEVEL. Empty array hides the Chillers section.

flashlampBoxes.description: Flashlamp box ids (e.g. PS5059:22..28). Empty array hides the Flashlamps section.

delayPresets.description: Trigger-delay preset values (ns) offered by the Set Trigger Delay control.

moduleErrors.description: Module-error indicator names → BI_<id>_ERR_<name>. Must list every CHILLER_<cid> matching chillerIds, plus non-chiller errors (e.g. REGEN, FLASHLAMPS).

commands.description: Commands this laser exposes. Buttons for commands not listed are hidden. Values are limited to the closed LASER_COMMANDS vocabulary.
